TITLE: Freshem groundwater chloride concentration model (Zeeland)
DESCRIPTION: Modelled 3D groundwater chloride concentration for the Freshem project, covering the Zeeland survey area, derived from GeoTOP lithology combined with airborne-EM resistivity. The cube provides chloride concentration percentiles (Q1-Q99) and mean, the GeoTOP unit used, and the top/bottom elevation of each depth layer on a regular x/y grid in the Dutch RD New projection (EPSG:28992), with a non-uniform vertical (z) axis following the original layer boundaries (no vertical interpolation).
HISTORY: Freshem prepare_data.py: GeoParquet point data (chloride percentiles per layer) resampled to regular x/y grid, converted to Zarr, variable names made Zarr/NTFS safe (z -> z_orig)
AUTHOR: Deltares
CITATION: Deltares Freshem project - groundwater chloride concentration model
COMMENT: Vertical axis z is layer-based, not a uniform grid: top/bottom variables give the real upper/lower elevation (m, Dutch NAP datum) of each layer at every x/y/z cell, so several z indices can share the same top or bottom. No interpolation is applied along z; values are the original per-layer values. Percentile variables (cl_q1 ... cl_q99) originate from parquet source columns of the same name.
